platform: Windows x64, Ubuntu 24.04 WSL2 for Linux tools
path_normalization: Staging root is replaced by <corpus>, workspace root by <workspace>, user home by <user-home>; interpreter paths use named placeholders. Paths within commands are normalized to POSIX separators. File bytes are unmodified.
